info.title: Affinity API
info.description: Affinity API for software platforms connecting practices to the compounder network.

get.description: Lists canonical formulation defaults. Requires a Live Affinity internal key with formulation_defaults:read.

put.description: Publishes a formulation-level default SIG and optional compounding-reason suggestion. Requires formulation_defaults:write.

delete.description: Retires the active defaults for one canonical formulation. Requires formulation_defaults:write.

get.description: Reads current pharmacy cost evidence and Affinity marketplace prices.

put.description: Merges item changes into the shared pharmacy pricing draft by default; mode=replace replaces the complete draft. Idempotency-Key is required. Pricing does not approve or make catalog items orderable.

post.description: Publishes the current shared draft as immutable pharmacy costs and marketplace price-book versions. Idempotency-Key is required.

get.description: Reads the active organization-specific Affinity price book for one pharmacy provider.

put.description: Publishes an immutable organization price-book version for one pharmacy. mode=merge (default) applies item updates onto the active book; mode=replace publishes only the supplied priced items. Null marketplaceUnitPriceCents removes a key in merge mode. Idempotency-Key is required.

post.description: Archives the active organization price book for one pharmacy so checkout falls back to default Affinity segment prices. Idempotent when no active book exists. Idempotency-Key is required.

get.description: Returns the platform organization and the current role.
Lists catalog items for the authenticated account and mode. When practiceId is supplied, a practice price overrides the platform price and missing overrides inherit the platform price.
Lists compounders available to the authenticated account, including approved invite-only relationships.
Returns at most 50 reviewed shipping services eligible for a catalog item, destination, and API mode.

post.description: Creates one or more patient orders for one practice and verified provider mapping. Each patient order contains 1–20 unsigned prescription drafts and remains independently reviewable and signable. A platform API key cannot sign them; create a provider-bound order signing session for each returned order. Idempotency-Key and actor context are required.
Cancels an order before shipment. To correct an order, cancel it and create a replacement.

get.description: Returns the subject, mode, and scopes for the API key.
Returns the practices that belong to the platform. The default Affinity-Version is 2026-08-11.

post.description: Creates a practice for the platform. Send Idempotency-Key when you retry the same request.

get.description: Returns one practice that belongs to the platform.

patch.description: Updates one practice that belongs to the platform. Send Idempotency-Key when you retry the same request.

get.description: Lists patients owned by one platform-managed practice in the current mode.

post.description: Creates or returns a synthetic or real patient by the platform's stable external ID. Idempotency-Key is required.

get.description: Returns one patient owned by the platform-managed practice.

patch.description: Updates one patient owned by the platform-managed practice.

get.description: Returns the patient's structured allergy entries and review status. A not_reviewed status is not a no-known-allergies assertion and blocks clinical review and signing.

put.description: Replaces the patient's structured allergy record. Sending no_known is the explicit no-known-allergies acknowledgement; recorded requires at least one entry. Idempotency-Key is required.

get.description: Lists platform-owned user records in the current Test or Live mode.

post.description: Creates or returns a user by the platform's stable external ID. Idempotency-Key is required.

get.description: Returns one platform-owned user in the current mode.

patch.description: Updates or deactivates a platform-owned user. Deactivation revokes grants and launch sessions, not the user's independent Affinity account.

get.description: Lists roles available for a platform-managed practice.

post.description: Creates a custom role for a platform-managed practice.

patch.description: Updates a custom role for a platform-managed practice.

delete.description: Deletes an unassigned custom role. Protected roles and roles with active assignments cannot be deleted.

get.description: Lists pending, active, and revoked platform membership grants.

post.description: Creates a pending role grant. The user must accept it in an Affinity Hosted launch before it becomes active.

patch.description: Changes a pending grant's role or revokes the grant.

get.description: Lists the platform's provider-to-Affinity identity mappings in the current Test or Live mode.

post.description: Links your platform's provider identity to a clinician in Affinity. Store the returned pmap_ ID and use it as providerMappingId for component or hosted sessions. Creating a mapping does not assert prescribing authority.

schema.description: The provider mapping ID returned by POST /v1/provider-mappings.

get.description: Returns the provider mapping and its current verification state. Use the mapping's pmap_ ID when you create component or hosted sessions.

schema.description: The provider mapping ID returned by POST /v1/provider-mappings.

patch.description: Revokes a provider mapping and every component, hosted, and delegated session issued through it.

post.description: Creates a one-time, origin-bound Affinity Elements client secret. The platform API key must stay on the server.
Creates a single-use Affinity Hosted workflow URL that expires after 15 minutes. The platform API key must stay on the server.
Creates a one-time Affinity Hosted URL where the mapped provider reviews and PIN-signs every prescription in one patient order. The provider PIN never reaches the platform.

externalId.description: Your platform's stable identifier for this provider.

id.description: The Affinity provider mapping ID. Store this pmap_ value and send it as providerMappingId when you create component or hosted sessions.

practiceId.description: The Affinity practice where this provider is authorized to act.

status.description: The mapping's verification state. Prescribing sessions require verified status.

userId.description: The Affinity user record for the person your platform authenticated.

verifiedAt.description: When Affinity verified this mapping, or null until verification is complete.
